literal: On renshen day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On renshen day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Eleventh month, on the guisi new moon, appointed Yelü Yuanfang, Zhang Ni, Han Zhide, and Xiao Fu chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day.
idiomatic: On the guisi new moon of the eleventh month Yelü Yuanfang, Zhang Ni, Han Zhide, and Xiao Fu were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day.

literal: On xinchou day, paid respects to the Empress Dowager and presented precious curios.
idiomatic: On xinchou day the Emperor paid respects to the Empress Dowager and presented precious curios.

literal: On gengshen day, reviewed prisoners.
idiomatic: On gengshen day prisoners were reviewed.

literal: Twelfth month, summoned several dozen skilled cuju players to the Eastern Capital, ordered them to compete against close ministers, the Emperor personally observed.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month several dozen skilled cuju players were summoned to the Eastern Capital to compete against close ministers while the Emperor watched.

literal: On jisi day, made Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan oversee Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs; Northern Chancellor Saba Ning was reappointed and concurrently Eastern Capital regent; Yelü Yingwen Southern Court chancellor; Zhagezhe Great Inner tiyin; Yishi Account Xiao Han Qianzhou military commissioner; Liu Liufu Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner; Princes' Household Guange princes' household langjun xiangwen; King Chujiong Pingzhou military commissioner; Grand Chancellor Zhang Ke'gong concurrent Minister of Works; Grand Chancellor Han Shaofang promoted to Palace Attendant; tiyin Yelü Maliu Northern Court xuanhui commissioner; foster father Yelü Xisun Southern Court chancellor.
idiomatic: On jisi day Imperial Younger Brother Chongyuan was appointed to oversee Northern and Southern Privy Council affairs; Northern Chancellor Saba Ning was reappointed and concurrently Eastern Capital regent; Yelü Yingwen was made Southern Court chancellor; Zhagezhe Great Inner tiyin; Yishi Account Xiao Han Qianzhou military commissioner; Liu Liufu Associate Administrative Affairs Commissioner; Princes' Household Guange princes' household langjun xiangwen; King Chujiong Pingzhou military commissioner; Grand Chancellor Zhang Ke'gong concurrent Minister of Works; Grand Chancellor Han Shaofang was promoted to Palace Attendant; tiyin Yelü Maliu Northern Court xuanhui commissioner; and foster father Yelü Xisun Southern Court chancellor.

literal: On guiwei day, Song dispatched Wang Juzheng and Zhang Shiyu to come congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
idiomatic: On guiwei day Song sent Wang Juzheng and Zhang Shiyu to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

literal: On jiashen day, ordered daily wine offerings at Great Tranquility Palace to offer devotion at Qing Mausoleum.
idiomatic: On jiashen day the court ordered daily wine offerings at Great Tranquility Palace in devotion at Qing Mausoleum.

literal: On dinghai day, reviewed prisoners; those not guilty of deliberate murder had penalties reduced.
idiomatic: On dinghai day prisoners were reviewed, and penalties were reduced for those not guilty of deliberate murder.

literal: Southern attendant Zhuangguli fraudulently seized Jurchen tribute goods, crime punishable by death; because the Emperor valued his administrative ability, he was tattooed and banished.
idiomatic: Southern attendant Zhuangguli fraudulently seized Jurchen tribute goods, a capital offense; because the Emperor valued his administrative ability, he was tattooed and banished instead.

literal: Eighth year, spring, first month, on the renchen new moon, Song dispatched Han Qi and Wang Congyi to come congratulate.
idiomatic: In the eighth year, on the renchen new moon of the first spring month, Song sent Han Qi and Wang Congyi to offer congratulations.

literal: On bingshen day, went to Huntong River to watch fishing.
idiomatic: On bingshen day the court went to Huntong River to watch the fishing.

literal: On wuxu day, relieved the Pin tribe.
idiomatic: On wuxu day relief was granted to the Pin tribe.

literal: On gengxu day, speared fish on the Shuaimoli River.
idiomatic: On gengxu day the court went ice fishing on the Shuaimoli River.

literal: On dingsi day, forbade selling sheep from Shuozhou to Song.
idiomatic: On dingsi day the sale of sheep from Shuozhou to Song was prohibited.

literal: Second month, on bingzi day, encamped at Changchun River.
idiomatic: On bingzi day of the second month the court encamped at Changchun River.

literal: Summer, sixth month, on yichou day, edict to survey household registers.
idiomatic: On yichou day of the sixth summer month an edict ordered a household registration survey.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on dingsi day, visited Qing Mausoleum and offered sacrifice at Wangxian Hall.
idiomatic: On dingsi day of the seventh autumn month the court visited Qing Mausoleum and offered sacrifice at Wangxian Hall.

literal: Welcomed the Empress Dowager to Xianzhou, visited the garden mausoleum, returned to the capital.
idiomatic: The Empress Dowager was escorted to Xianzhou, the garden mausoleum was visited, and the court returned to the capital.

literal: Winter, tenth month, encamped at the Eastern Capital.
idiomatic: In the tenth winter month the court encamped at the Eastern Capital.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiawu day, edict: those reporting Northern Court handling as unjust, whether by striking the bell or intercepting the imperial procession, all are to be submitted to the throne.
idiomatic: On jiawu day of the eleventh month an edict ordered that anyone reporting unfair handling by the Northern Court, whether by striking the bell or intercepting the imperial procession, must have the matter submitted to the throne.

literal: On wuxu day, attended court before the Empress Dowager and summoned monks to discuss Buddhist dharma.
idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor attended the Empress Dowager at court and summoned monks to discuss Buddhist teaching.

literal: On wushen day, the Empress Dowager performed the regeneration rite; general amnesty.
idiomatic: On wushen day the Empress Dowager performed the regeneration rite and a general amnesty was proclaimed.

literal: On jiyou day, fortified Changchun.
idiomatic: On jiyou day Changchun was fortified.

literal: Intercalary twelfth month, on renchen day, visited King of Wu Xiao Xiaomu's illness.
idiomatic: On renchen day of the intercalary twelfth month the Emperor visited King of Wu Xiao Xiaomu, who was ill.

literal: Song dispatched Pang Ji and Du Zan to come congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.
idiomatic: Song sent Pang Ji and Du Zan to congratulate the Eternal Longevity Festival.

literal: Ninth year, spring, first month, on the bingchen new moon, the Emperor presented wine at the Empress Dowager's palace and held court at the main hall.
idiomatic: In the ninth year, on the bingchen new moon of the first spring month, the Emperor offered wine at the Empress Dowager's palace and held court in the main hall.

literal: Song dispatched Wang Gongchen and Peng Zaisi to come congratulate.
idiomatic: Song sent Wang Gongchen and Peng Zaisi to offer congratulations.

literal: On gengshen day, went to Yazi River.
idiomatic: On gengshen day the court went to Yazi River.

literal: Second month, encamped at Yu'er Marsh.
idiomatic: In the second month the court encamped at Yu'er Marsh.

literal: Third month, on xinwei day, on the occasion of the Responding Sage Festival, general amnesty.
idiomatic: On xinwei day of the third month a general amnesty was proclaimed for the Responding Sage Festival.

literal: Fifth month, on the yimao new moon, summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.
idiomatic: On the yimao new moon of the fifth month the court took the summer retreat at Yong'an Mountain.

literal: Sixth month, shot willow to pray for rain.
idiomatic: In the sixth month the court performed the willow-shooting rite to pray for rain.

literal: Autumn, seventh month, on guiyou day, Song dispatched Guo Zhen to report attacking Xia; dispatched Privy Council commissioner Du Fang on a return mission.
idiomatic: On guiyou day of the seventh autumn month Song sent Guo Zhen to report its campaign against Western Xia; Privy Council commissioner Du Fang was dispatched on a return mission.

literal: On dingchou day, went to Autumn Mountain.
idiomatic: On dingchou day the court went to Autumn Mountain.

literal: Winter, tenth month, on the guiwei new moon, encamped at Zhonghuichuan.
idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Zhonghuichuan.

literal: Eleventh month, on jiazi day, Jurchen raided the border; Huanglong Prefecture Tieli Army was dispatched to repel them.
idiomatic: On jiazi day of the eleventh month Jurchen raided the border, and the Tieli Army of Huanglong Prefecture was mobilized to repel them.

literal: Song dispatched Su Shen and Xiang Chuanfan to come congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.
idiomatic: Song sent Su Shen and Xiang Chuanfan to congratulate the Responding Sage Festival.

literal: Twelfth month, on gengyin day, because a Northern Great King Household Buwei Account langjun claimed his ancestors had intermarried with the state, permission was granted to establish a chanshi; Xiao Hudu of his account was ordered to fill the post.
idiomatic: On gengyin day of the twelfth month, because a langjun of the Northern Great King Household's Buwei Account claimed ancestral marriage ties with the dynasty, permission was granted to establish a chanshi, and Xiao Hudu of that account was appointed to the post.

literal: On xinmao day, established Suzhou with the Jurchen households that had been obtained.
idiomatic: On xinmao day Suzhou was established with the Jurchen households that had been obtained.

literal: Appointed Xiao Di, Liu Sangui, Yelü Yuanfang, Wang Weiji, Yelü Shuzhong, Sun Wenzhao, Xiao Shaojun, and Qin Dechang chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and New Year's Day of the coming year.
idiomatic: Xiao Di, Liu Sangui, Yelü Yuanfang, Wang Weiji, Yelü Shuzhong, Sun Wenzhao, Xiao Shaojun, and Qin Dechang were appointed chief and deputy envoys to congratulate Song on birthdays and on New Year's Day of the coming year.

literal: Edict: all lawbreakers may not serve as officials; all officers except at weddings and sacrifices may not sink into drunkenness and neglect duties.
idiomatic: An edict declared that convicted offenders may not hold office and that officials may not become drunk and neglect their duties except at weddings and sacrifices.

literal: Those having plans for governing the people and securing the borders, fully submit reports.
idiomatic: Those with plans for governing the people and securing the borders were ordered to submit full reports.
